Oslo family guide: 25 places, the way a local would tell you, with real prices, hours and one tap to Maps.

render.hook: Bois de la Cambre: A large wood with a lake and an island. Children can run on the paths and watch the ducks.

mediaAltText: Brussels family guide pin: Bois de la Cambre: A large wood with a lake and an island. Children can run on the paths and watch the ducks.
info.text:
Dinosaurs, trains, parks and good frites for children of every age, with options. 24 places

Skip: the restaurants on Rue des Bouchers near the Grand Place. They push tourist menus at €30 or more and the mussels are mediocre. Eat at Au Vieux Saint Martin or buy frites at Frit Flagey instead.

render.hook: 't Dreupelkot: Ask for a taster of two or three flavours before you commit. Strong, so have water too.

mediaAltText: Ghent nightlife guide pin: 't Dreupelkot: Ask for a taster of two or three flavours before you commit. Strong, so have water too.
info.text:
Old brown pubs, a jenever bar, proper cocktails, blues and free gigs, with the late-night rules locals know. 24 places

Skip: the terraces on Graslei and Korenlei. You pay a canal-view premium (a beer is often €1 to €2 more) for average food. Drink at Het Waterhuis aan de Bierkant or 't Dreupelkot instead, both a minute away and cheaper.
